extraction_notes: Extracted experimental catalyst-performance entries from SI Table S1 on page 6. Figures S9 duplicates CO2 conversion data in the table and was not separately extracted. Figures S10 and S11 show time-evolution/selectivity traces but are dense plots and/or duplicate table-averaged catalytic tests; no plot-read numeric records were extracted. Figure S15 reports CO formation rate, for which this schema has no dedicated field; it was not used as methanol STY. SI page 10 literature-comparison table was not extracted for literature rows; its 'This work' rows were used only to add pressure, GHSV, and the four reported STY values to matching records.
